question_text: The list of requirements, along with the budget estimates, _____ reviewed by the board.
explanation: B. was. Subjek utamanya 'the list' (tunggal), jadi passive-nya 'was reviewed'. Frasa 'along with the budget estimates' cuma sisipan yang nggak mengubah jumlah subjek. 'were' jamak, 'have' dan 'has' nggak cocok untuk passive 'reviewed' di sini.

question_text: Each of the applicants _____ required to submit two letters of recommendation.
explanation: C. is. 'Each of' selalu diikuti verb tunggal karena fokusnya tiap individu, bukan kelompok. 'are', 'were', dan 'have' semuanya jamak, salah untuk pola 'each of + plural noun'.

question_text: The number of students enrolling _____ grown steadily over the past decade.
explanation: A. has. 'The number of' berarti 'jumlah' (satu angka) jadi tunggal, maka 'has grown'. Hati-hati: beda dengan 'a number of' yang artinya 'sejumlah' dan bersifat jamak. Ini jebakan klasik TOEFL.

question_text: A number of issues _____ been raised during the meeting.
explanation: B. have. 'A number of' artinya 'sejumlah' (banyak item) jadi jamak, maka 'have been raised'. Jangan tertukar dengan 'the number of' yang tunggal. 'Of issues' di sini justru penanda jamak.

question_text: Neither the coach nor the players _____ willing to accept the decision.
explanation: B. were. Aturan 'neither...nor': verb mengikuti subjek TERDEKAT, yaitu 'the players' (jamak), jadi 'were willing'. 'was' dan 'is' tunggal, sedangkan 'has' nggak cocok dengan 'willing'.

question_text: Rarely _____ such a dedicated team of volunteers.
explanation: B. have we seen. Keterangan negatif 'Rarely' di awal kalimat memicu INVERSION: subjek dan aux dibalik jadi 'have we seen'. Opsi A dan C tanpa inversion, D 'did we saw' salah bentuk (double past).

question_text: Under no circumstances _____ leave the laboratory without permission.
explanation: B. should you. 'Under no circumstances' adalah frasa negatif di awal, maka terjadi inversion: 'should you leave'. 'You should' benar secara grammar tapi urutannya salah karena inversion. 'Will you to' double form, salah.

question_text: Not until the final chapter _____ the reader fully understand the plot.
explanation: A. does. Pola 'Not until X' memicu inversion: 'the reader' subjek tunggal, jadi aux 'does' ditambah verb dasar 'understand'. 'do' untuk subjek jamak, 'has' dan 'will' nggak cocok dengan 'understand'.

question_text: No sooner had the train departed _____ the passengers realized they had left their bags behind.
explanation: A. than. Pasangan tetap 'No sooner ... than': begitu kereta berangkat, penumpang sadar. 'when', 'that', dan 'then' bukan pasangan yang benar untuk pola ini.

question_text: Scarcely had she begun her speech _____ the microphone stopped working.
explanation: A. when. Pasangan tetap 'Scarcely ... when': baru mulai pidato, mic langsung mati. 'than' dipakai untuk 'no sooner', jadi nggak bisa dipakai di sini.

question_text: The committee recommended that the proposal _____ before the next meeting.
explanation: A. be discussed. Verb 'recommended that' menuntut SUBJUNCTIVE: verb bentuk dasar 'be discussed', bukan 'is' atau 'was'. Subjunctive nggak berubah bentuk meski subjeknya tunggal.

question_text: It is essential that every participant _____ arrive on time.
explanation: B. arrive. Ekspresi 'It is essential that' menuntut subjunctive, jadi verb bentuk dasar 'arrive', bukan 'arrives'. Bentuk subjunctive selalu tanpa -s, ini aturan klasik TOEFL.

question_text: The manager insisted that the report _____ completed by Friday.
explanation: A. be. 'Insisted that' menuntut subjunctive: 'the report be completed', bukan 'is' atau 'was completed'. Verb 'insist' termasuk kelompok kata yang selalu diikuti subjunctive bare form.

question_text: It was not until the 1950s _____ color television became widely available.
explanation: B. that. Pola tetap 'It was not until X that Y'. Banyak yang tergoda memilih 'when', tapi pola ini Wajib 'that'. Ini struktur favorit soal TOEFL.

question_text: The more you practice, _____ you become.
explanation: A. the more fluent. Pola 'the + comparative, the + comparative' untuk hubungan sebab-akibat: makin sering latihan, makin lancar. 'More fluent' tanpa 'the' nggak valid di pola ini.
